title: DOJ Indictment Shadows Kevin Spacey Film – Co-Writer Charged in $340M Crypto Ponzi
summary: A Kevin Spacey film connected to a crypto ponzi case has made headlines. Co-writer Vladimir Okhotnikov has faced DOJ and SEC charges tied to Forsage, accused of taking $340M.
